notes.title: In Search of Heroes! - Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Greetings Heroes!
We have finally done it! In Search of Heroes has officially entered into Early Access! After several years of hard work, we are proud to finally show off everything we have poured into this. With this release comes some new features and bug fixes. We have lot of new features and updates planned, and have already begun working on them! Check out our roadmap for a preview of what's to come!

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2872910/extras/banner_roadmap.png?t=1743885989[/img]

Though we have been creating small games for over a decade now this is our first time releasing a fully featured game to the public. Please be patient with us in this process. If you run into any bugs or issues, please post it in the Steam Community forms so that we can work on solving any issues as quickly as possible. We check this frequently and are keeping a close eye out for pesky bugs!

Now, get out there Heroes! There are enemies to slay, treasures to collect, and quests to complete!
